notes.title: Streamer Friendly Music
notes.notes: [h1]New original music![/h1][p]Our fantastic sound designer, Chris Bolte, has created new original music for the game. It plays in the shop. We like it a lot.[/p][p][/p][h2]Safe for streamers[/h2][p]This music will replace the old music which we had licensed. We own this music and we have made sure that streamers will NOT get any copyright notices from it on YouTube, Twitch or any other streaming platform. [/p][p][/p][h2]What about the old music?[/h2][p]Change is hard. We understand if you got used to the old music and miss it. You can always listen to the old shop music here if you want to feel nostalgic [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/61Mh5SniJu8"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Details for nerds[/h3][p]This is all way more than most people would want to read, but if you're curious then go ahead! The way that music licensing works on YouTube is weird. We've learned the hard way that YouTube still flags licensed music even though the license is supposed to allow streamers and other folks to include the music as part of their gameplay videos. While there are steps that streamers can take to clear these flags, that is work that we don't want to put on them. We love streamers and want it to be as easy as possible for them to make videos about our game. That's why we made original music which should never be flagged at all.[/p]

notes.title: Alpha is Available!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]You can play the alpha version of Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game today! We are using the steam playtest feature to distribute it. It is open to anyone. [b]Click the "Request Access" button on the playtesting widget[/b] and you'll be granted access automatically.  [/p][p][/p][p]How is this different than a demo? [/p][list][*][p]This alpha is less complete than a demo would be. [b]Everything is still subject to change[/b], even major mechanics. The downside to this is that we might remove your favorite card or mechanic. The upside is that you can join our discord and advocate for your perspective. We take our players seriously and listen to all their concerns. We've already incorporated feedback from our pre-alpha on itch.io.  [/p][/*][*][p]In most demos, content is withheld so that players still want to buy the full game. We are not withholding any content with this alpha. We're giving you everything we have in the hopes that we'll be able to make the game better faster this way. On the flip side, when we do release our demo this playtest alpha will become unplayable for the same reason (why would anyone pay for the full game if they could play the exact same stuff for free through a playtest?)[/p][/*][*][p]There will be many bugs. The game will be unbalanced at times. We need your feedback to make it better! [b]Join our discord and let us know [url="https://discord.gg/TXXsHrYY5s"]https://discord.gg/TXXsHrYY5s[/url].[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list]
